C0471.title: Former Employee Sentenced to 16 Months for Stealing 3.7 Million Loyalty Points
C0471.summary: Between November 2021 and February 2022, a former employee of a shopping mall in Jing'an District, Shanghai, repeatedly infiltrated the mall to steal nearly 3.7 million loyalty points using retained account credentials and knowledge of the points management system.
